items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mr. Bottoms, Bill Bottoms, who turned out to be Joe Louis's dietician, he owned the Dreamland.

ctx.x: Now, after I -- well, then from the De Luxe I went across to Dreamland, and there's where Mr. Bottoms, Bill Bottoms, who turned out to be Joe Louis's dietician, he owned the Dreamland.
